requirements.text: Any new functionalities must align with GDPR, PSD2, and Central Bank regulations.
Basic transaction notifications are potential functionalities to explore.
Account freezing features are potential functionalities to explore.
Customer consent must be obtained where necessary for any new feature.
Strong authentication measures need to be implemented for these functionalities.
There must be clear processes for monitoring and addressing compliance issues post-implementation.
Compliance must be prioritized in every aspect of the project, with careful assessment of regulatory implications for all features.
